verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms AgentMail serves an llms.txt (HTTP 200 at docs.agentmail.to/llms.txt). The docs are published as markdown pages, an OpenAPI spec is reachable, and an installable agent skills package plus an agent-driven self-registration quickstart make the docs directly agent-consumable. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or a first-party page explaining how to point agents at the docs, and no independent community corroboration of agents using them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: This works with Claude Code, Cursor, OpenClaw, Codex, and other compatible agents: npx skills add agentmail-to/agentmail-skills
The agent registers itself using an email you provide and receives an API key in response.
